summary: Iteration 22 — Cloudinary video codec rewrite (bug fix) + PATCH /api/posts/{id} edit endpoint (new feature) both fully working end-to-end. 14/14 new backend tests pass (browser_compatible_video_url unit tests, /api/feed rewriting Cloudinary URLs while leaving /api/uploads/ untouched, PATCH owner happy path, non-owner 404, empty body 422, nonexistent 404, edited_at null on new posts + set after edit, DELETE still works). Full regression: 30/30 iteration 19/20/21 tests still green. Frontend Playwright e2e passed all 5 scenarios: Edit+Delete buttons only on own posts, edit happy path with (edited) indicator, edit cancel reverts, empty-body disables Save, delete removes post from feed.
critical_code_review_comments: cloud_storage.browser_compatible_video_url (lines 126-137) is correctly guarded: skips non-Cloudinary URLs, skips URLs without /upload/, and skips URLs that already contain the transform — so double-injection is impossible. Uses str.replace with count=1 which is the safest form.

posts_router.py _hydrate_posts wraps the constructed video_url through the helper (line 123). This is applied both for Cloudinary secure_urls (post['video_path'] starting with http) and, harmlessly, for the /api/uploads/ path (helper is a no-op there because 'res.cloudinary.com' is not in the string). Correct.

posts_router.py PATCH endpoint (~line 359) uses a proper Pydantic model with min_length=1/max_length=1000, then strips before hitting update_post_body. Empty body -> Pydantic 422. Non-owner correctly gets 404 with detail 'Post not found or not yours' because the Mongo filter includes author_uid. Response is re-hydrated through the same batched pipeline so nice_count / comment_count / is_mine / author stay correct.
posts.update_post_body uses find_one_and_update with ReturnDocument.AFTER — returns the actual persisted doc, avoiding the race where a follow-up find could miss the write. Good.
models.PostOut adds edited_at: Optional[str] between created_at and author — matches spec. PostOut.model_rebuild() still called after CommentOut is defined, so the forward ref resolves.

Feed.jsx: Save button is `disabled={editSaving || !editDraft.trim()}` — matches spec ('Save disabled OR error'). (edited) indicator is gated on truthy post.edited_at, so freshly-created posts don't show it. Video element also gained playsInline (verified by spec, not directly tested in e2e).
test_credentials: Uses REACT_APP_FIREBASE_API_KEY Identity Toolkit signUp. Ephemeral TEST_i22_* users created + deleted at teardown.
seed_data_creation: Two ephemeral Firebase users (user_a / user_b) for PATCH auth tests. Two seeded Mongo post docs (one Cloudinary URL, one bare filename) for the feed-rewrite tests, both deleted in the finally block. One frontend signup user (TEST_i22ui_*) leaves a couple of posts + a Firebase account behind — same pattern as previous iterations, admin cleanup not required.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 22 is fully green. All backend endpoints + frontend flows for the video codec fix and the Edit Post feature work as specified. Regression suite from iterations 19/20/21 also still passes. If the next iteration touches posts_router.py or Feed.jsx, re-run /app/backend/tests/test_iteration22.py and the Playwright script in this report's script section (signup → skip photo → compose 'original text' → edit → cancel → edit → save → delete).
rca of the issue: N/A — all specified behavior is implemented correctly.
